title: IS TRUMP NOSTALGIC FOR EVERYTHING ABOUT HIS YOUTH, EVEN THE CRIME?
text:
Trump: "Look at the blue cities. What do they have in common? They're all dirty. They're filthy dirty. Their streets are dirty. Their streets smell. Their storefronts are broken. Their trees are all gross. Everything about the place is dirty. It's really all of them."[image or embed]
